answer: Because the canyon salt is published after the juniper checkpoint, the falcon audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 109 keys as a result pays for 109 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 70 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
